what: The Mesen measurements of streambound-curve.json were taken on the generator in curve.provenance.generator. This record certifies they stand for the generator in finalGenerator: every record that ran Mesen was rebuilt on that tree, with no Mesen, by the sweep's own scene builder, and its project hash and ROM hash equal the recorded ones. A later generator-only change is certified by re-running test/lua/sw_rebuild_check.mjs; a change whose ROMs differ needs a re-sweep. (Re-made 2026-10-23 for Growth profiles (ROADMAP item 5) R1, over the fresh re-sweep on the tree after commits D1 and C1-C4, with the unchanged engine and harness and the generator of those commits: recordedGenerator equals finalGenerator, because the sweep ran on the generator the tree has now, so the rebuild check is a plain confirmation that every record rebuilds to its recorded project and ROM. Every ROM and measurement equals the previous sweep's; the only project differences are the defaulted empty growthProfiles array and the null profileId of each party member.)
